Reaching eligibility takes 40 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 40 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 8 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
